events.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match (Lens).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (Club Brugge).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Matthieu Udol (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Club Brugge 1, Lens 0. Hans Vanaken (Club Brugge) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a corner.
Substitution, Lens. Jean-Clair Todibo replaces Samson Baidoo.
Goal! Club Brugge 2, Lens 0. Joaquin Seys (Club Brugge) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Substitution, Lens. Odsonne Édouard replaces Franjo Ivanovic.
Substitution, Lens. Florian Thauvin replaces Thorgan Hazard.
Félix Lemaréchal (Club Brugge) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Hugo Vetlesen replaces Félix Lemaréchal.
Substitution, Lens. Yacine Titraoui replaces Amadou Haidara.
Goal! Club Brugge 3, Lens 0. Carlos Forbs (Club Brugge) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Hugo Vetlesen.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Mamadou Diakhon replaces Jan Virgili.
Hugo Vetlesen (Club Brugge) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Michal Skóras (Lens) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Romeo Vermant replaces Nicolò Tresoldi.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Hugo Siquet replaces Kyriani Sabbe.
Substitution, Club Brugge. Milan Robberechts replaces Carlos Forbs.
Substitution, Lens. Kyllian Antonio replaces Ruben Aguilar.
Second Half ends, Club Brugge 3, Lens 0.
